item.title: Electronic Monitoring Technology Supports Safer Reentry
item.summary: Securus Monitoring is highlighting how connected electronic monitoring technology can give probation and parole officers real-time visibility while allowing people under supervision to remain at home, work, and take part in family life. The company is demonstrating its monitoring technology at the American Probation and Parole Association Annual Training Institute in Chicago from August 16 […] The post Electronic Monitoring Technology Supports Safer Reentry appeared first on eeNews Europe .
